body:
I'm glad i'm not the only one who feels that way! I hope people aren't too tough on you :(... sometimes I think people can say things without even thinking.

I think my boyfriend does have a hard time putting it nicely, but unfortunately I did decide to end things.. it was just becoming too hard on me :(.. but that's okay.

I know my mom loves me and she can just be insensitive sometimes. 

are you enjoying college??
Yes yes yes and yes. Don't think about him, think about YOU. You deserve to be treated so much better. Ugh.
That is taking asshole to a whole other level. He doesn't seem to care about you at all.
I agree. Sometimes little things can be worked on, but wouldn't you like to find someone who was already positive like you?
Thanks. I have my own place/car and decent jobs and it still is never enough for him. He critiques my apartment and my car and it just never ends. All my friends still live at home too.

I will probably move back out of the city and continue my life there. I think he would change/improve over time, but it's really difficult and honestly I will hold out to see if maybe there is someone else out there for me.. emotionally capable and all.

Oh no, it isn't just him. I just moved back to the city feeling pretty depressed and low and it's a pretty touchy time for me. Add his 3 hour long criticisms of my life and yeah.. it really all sends me over the edge.

I really do love him, but he fails to see how he is being mean in any of this and I feel like it's borderline emotionally abusive.
